title: Dou Bao Recommended Hotels Start Charging Fees: TikTok Laike Introduces Service Fee Policy for Specific Channels

content_html:
According to reports, hotel bookings that are redirected through the Doubao entry point to TikTok Laike will now be subject to a new independent rate policy. Starting from August 10, relevant orders will be charged a software service fee of 11.4% and a payment processing fee of 0.6%, with an overall rate of approximately 12%.

Several industry insiders in the hotel sector have confirmed the authenticity of this news, which comes from the TikTok Laike merchant back office. Industry experts said that hotel bookings generated through Doubao recommendations have already begun to be included in the commission settlement system. ByteDance has not yet responded to this issue.

According to the "2026 TikTok Life Service Platform Specific Channel Software Service Fee Policy Statement" released by the TikTok Life Services Learning Center, this policy is effective starting at 0:00 on August 10, 2026, and continues until 24:00 on the day before the new specific channel software service fee policy takes effect. The specific software service fee rates will be displayed to merchants through the TikTok Laike merchant back office.

According to the policy statement, the base for calculating the software service fee is the actual amount paid by the user plus any subsidy amounts provided by entities other than the merchant, such as platform-wide coupons. The rate will be fixed or range-based depending on the merchant type, product category, POI category, product type, and specific transaction channels.

Doubao has been included in the specific transaction channel scope, and the platform may adjust the related rates based on service conditions. Whether a specific order belongs to a specific channel is determined by the order settlement slip. Merchants can check the corresponding group purchase product rates through the TikTok Laike back office.

This adjustment shows that as AI entry points gradually connect to e-commerce, local life, and other transaction scenarios, platforms are exploring commercial models after AI traffic conversion. In the future, consumer entrances brought by AI assistants may become a new transaction growth channel for internet platforms.

content_html_zh:
据报道，通过豆宝入口点重定向到TikTok来客的酒店预订现在将受到新的独立房价政策的约束。 自8月10日起，相关订单将收取11.4%的软件服务费和0.6%的支付处理费，总体费率约为12%。

多位酒店界业内人士证实了这一消息的真实性，该消息来自TikTok莱客商户后台。 业内专家表示，通过豆宝推荐产生的酒店预订已经开始纳入佣金结算系统。 字节跳动尚未对此问题作出回应。

根据抖音生活服务学习中心发布的《2026年抖音生活服务平台特定渠道软件服务收费政策声明》，本政策自2026年8月10日0:00起生效，持续至新的特定渠道软件服务收费政策生效前一天24:00。 具体软件服务费率将通过TikTok来客商户后台向商户展示。

根据政策声明，软件服务费的计算基础是用户实际支付的金额加上商家以外的实体提供的任何补贴金额，例如全平台优惠券。 根据商户类型、产品类别、POI 类别、产品类型和特定交易渠道，费率将是固定的或基于范围的。

豆宝已纳入特定交易渠道范围，平台可根据服务情况调整相关费率。 特定订单是否属于特定渠道由订单结算单决定。 商家可以通过TikTok来客后台查看对应的团购产品费率。

此次调整表明，随着AI入口点逐渐对接电商、本地生活等交易场景，平台正在探索AI流量转化后的商业模式。 未来，AI助手带来的消费者入口或将成为互联网平台新的交易增长渠道。
